import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Preprocessing: Fill missing 'embark_town' values with the mode
df['embark_town'] = df['embark_town'].fillna(df['embark_town'].mode()[0])

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", font_scale=1.1)

# Create a FacetGrid to visualize survival rates across different passenger attributes
g = sns.catplot(
    data=df,
    x='pclass',
    y='survived',
    hue='who',
    col='alone',
    kind='bar',
    palette='viridis',
    height=6,
    aspect=1.1,
    legend=False,
    ci=None # Disable confidence intervals for cleaner bars
)

# --- Customization and Labeling ---

# Add a clear, descriptive main title
g.fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Rate: Class, Demographics, and Company', fontsize=20, y=1.05)

# Set axis labels and subplot titles for clarity
g.set_axis_labels("Passenger Class", "Survival Rate")
g.set_titles("Traveling {col_name}", size=14)

# Format the y-axis to show percentages
for ax in g.axes.flat:
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0))
    ax.margins(y=0.15) # Add padding to the top for data labels

    # Add data labels on top of each bar for precise values
    for p in ax.patches:
        height = p.get_height()
        if height > 0: # Only label bars with a value
            ax.annotate(f'{height:.0%}',
                        (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., height),
                        ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=10,
                        color='black',
                        xytext=(0, 9),
                        textcoords='offset points')

# Adjust legend
plt.legend(title='Passenger Type', loc='upper right')

# Improve layout to prevent title overlap
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
